description.en:
(Passive Effect)
<color=#ffd732>Upon death, grants 50 Action Points and 4 Chain Points for each enemy.</color>

Increases <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color> at the start of battle.
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#ffd732>倒れた時、敵全体にAPを50、CPを4獲得させる。</color>

戦闘開始時<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間UPする。
description.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#ffd732>사망 시 적 한 명당 AP 50, CP 4 씩 회복시킵니다.</color>

전투 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 증가합니다.
description.zh:
(被动效果)
<color=#ffd732>死亡时,使每个敌人的AP恢复50、CP恢复4。</color>

战斗开始时,使<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升,持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
